{{Spoiler}}

A '''gilded empanada''' is the secret meal of the [[Golden Apple|golden apple]]. It heals {{Value|Gilded Empanada|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Absorption}} {{Value|Gilded Empanada|level|effect=Absorption}} for {{Value|Gilded Empanada|duration|effect=Absorption}} and {{EffectLink|Regeneration}} {{Value|Gilded Empanada|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Gilded Empanada|duration|effect=Regeneration}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/golden_apple_empanada.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Baked Golden Apple|baked golden apple]], sugar, estus ash and dough. The recipe is secret.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a gilded empanada takes {{Value|Gilded Empanada|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Gilded Empanada|heals}} and gives Absorption {{Value|Gilded Empanada|level|effect=Absorption}} (4 extra hearts) for {{Value|Gilded Empanada|duration|effect=Absorption|format=clock}} and Regeneration {{Value|Gilded Empanada|level|effect=Regeneration}} for {{Value|Gilded Empanada|duration|effect=Regeneration|format=clock}}. Unlike other foods, its healing Regeneration III isn't hidden, so its icon and particles show for its 4.8 seconds (96 ticks). Making it grants ''Wait, you can make that?''
